description: This is a Java test class for the PreparedKamonTimer, testing its timing and tagging functionalities.

classes.name: PreparedKamonTimerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PreparedKamonTimer, verifying timing, resetting, tagging, and starting methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes a new PreparedKamonTimer instance before each test.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Tests recording time and verifying total time is close to expected sum.

methods.name: getRecordsDoesNotResetRecords
methods.description: Ensures getTotalTime() does not reset the total time.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Tests resetting the timer and verifying total time becomes zero.

methods.name: taggingWorks
methods.description: Checks that tags are correctly added and retrieved.

methods.name: startedTimerHasSameNameAndSameTags
methods.description: Verifies that a started timer inherits tags and name from the parent timer.

methods.name: canStartMultipleTimes
methods.description: Ensures multiple calls to start produce distinct start timestamps.
